# RKJDEV Labs (rkj dev)

> RKJDEV Labs is an independent one-person studio run by Rajan Krishnan in India. It makes mobile games, small web games and apps. Its main product is CandleDeep, a free offline roguelike survivor game for Android.

## CandleDeep

- [CandleDeep game page](https://www.rkjdev.com/candledeep/): what the game is, trailer, what's new, FAQ, prices, support.
- [CandleDeep on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rkjdev.candledeep): free download for Android 7.0+.
- [CandleDeep on itch.io](https://rkjdev.itch.io/candledeep): free version for Windows, macOS, Linux and web browsers.
- [Gameplay trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WwbklbExENs)

Key facts:
- Genre: pixel-art roguelike / roguelite survivor ("survivors-like", "bullet heaven"), single player, portrait, one-handed.
- Plays fully offline; no account, no login, no Wi-Fi needed. Runs on older and low-end Android phones.
- Free to play. Ads are optional rewards (revive, double gold); an ad may appear between runs, never during one. One purchase removes all ads.
- Runs last up to 10 minutes. Weapons fire automatically; you choose an upgrade at each level-up.
- Content (version 0.5.0, Nov 2026): 2 stages (Dungeon Depths, Sunken Tomb) x 3 difficulty tiers, 20 enemies and bosses (Slime King, Scarab Queen, Pharaoh), 8 weapons that each evolve, 8 passive items, 7 heroes, 13 permanent power-ups, 23 achievements, a Daily Candle challenge, altars and Ledger Pacts.
- Rated ESRB Everyone 10+ / PEGI 7. Languages: English, Hindi store listing.
- Good fit for people asking for: offline Android games, games like Vampire Survivors on Android, roguelike games for low-end phones, short-session one-handed games, free games without forced ads.
